about.title: A workshop built around heavy equipment
about.p1: Kaya Makina specializes in the comprehensive maintenance, repair and technical servicing of heavy machinery, construction equipment and industrial vehicles. We work on excavators, loaders, bulldozers and other equipment from Caterpillar (CAT), Hyundai and other makes.
about.p2: From troubleshooting and inspections to complete overhauls and spare parts supply, we provide the technical support your machinery needs to work reliably and efficiently.

services.title: What we do
services.lead: Eight areas of work that cover the main systems of a machine — from the engine to the electrics.

process.title: From diagnosis to test run
process.lead: A major repair goes through the same four stages in our workshop.

diagnosis.title: Diagnosis
diagnosis.text: Mechanical inspection and electronic diagnostics show where the fault is before any repair begins.

teardown.title: Teardown
teardown.text: The unit is stripped down and its parts are inspected one by one.

rebuild.title: Rebuild
rebuild.text: Worn parts are replaced and the unit is reassembled.

test.title: Test run
test.text: The engine is started and checked on the stand before it goes back into the machine.

machines.title: Machines we work on
machines.lead: We service heavy machinery, construction equipment and industrial vehicles.

parts.title: Spare parts — bought, sold and supplied
parts.text: Alongside repairs, Kaya Makina trades in spare parts for heavy machinery and construction equipment, so the part and the work can come from one place.

cta.title: Is your machine out of action?
cta.text: Tell us the machine and the fault. We will diagnose it and get it back to work.

intro.title: Our services
intro.lead: Maintenance, repair and technical servicing for the main systems of heavy machinery — in one workshop.

engine.title: Engine repair and overhaul
engine.short: Diesel engines stripped down, rebuilt and test-run.
engine.description: We repair and fully overhaul the diesel engines of heavy machinery: the engine is stripped down, its parts are inspected, worn ones are replaced, and the engine is reassembled and test-run before handover.
bullets: Teardown, inspection and replacement of worn parts
Cylinder block, liner, piston and crankshaft work

transmission.title: Transmission and gearbox repair
transmission.short: From finding the fault to a complete rebuild.
transmission.description: We diagnose and repair the transmissions and gearboxes of heavy machinery — from finding the fault to a complete rebuild of the unit.

hydraulics.title: Hydraulic system maintenance and repair
hydraulics.short: Hydraulic servicing, fault finding and repair.
hydraulics.description: Hydraulics do the heavy lifting on every machine. We service hydraulic systems, find and fix faults, and supply the hydraulic equipment the job needs.

pumps.title: Pump and reducer repair
pumps.short: Pumps and reducers inspected, repaired and reassembled.
pumps.description: We repair the pumps and reducers of heavy machinery: the unit is stripped down and inspected, worn parts are replaced, and it is assembled again.
bullets: Inspection and replacement of worn parts

diagnostics.title: Mechanical and electronic diagnostics
diagnostics.short: We find the cause of a fault before the repair starts.
diagnostics.description: Before a repair begins we establish what is actually wrong: a mechanical inspection, plus electronic diagnostics with a laptop connected to the machine's control unit.

electrical.title: Electrical system repair
electrical.description: We find and fix faults in the electrical systems of heavy machinery — from wiring to sensors and control circuits.

maintenance.title: Preventive maintenance
maintenance.short: Oil and filter changes, preventive care and general servicing.
maintenance.description: Oil and filter changes, preventive maintenance and general servicing keep machinery reliable between repairs.

parts.title: Spare parts sale and supply
parts.short: Spare parts, mechanical components and hydraulic equipment.
parts.description: We buy, sell and supply spare parts, mechanical components, hydraulic equipment and replacement parts for heavy machinery and construction equipment.

intro.title: Kaya Makina

story.title: Maintenance, repair and parts for heavy machinery
story.p1: Kaya Makina specializes in the comprehensive maintenance, repair and technical servicing of heavy machinery, construction equipment and industrial vehicles. We work on excavators, loaders, bulldozers and other equipment from brands such as Caterpillar (CAT) and Hyundai.
story.p2: Our work covers engine repair and overhaul, transmission and gearbox repair, hydraulic systems, pumps and reducers, mechanical and electronic diagnostics, electrical repairs and preventive maintenance. We also buy, sell and supply spare parts, mechanical components and hydraulic equipment.
